fusions.name: Windborne Bloom
fusions.desc: Beats out a cone of spores 5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it, each with a 50% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gleaned Remains
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Pecks it for 16 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Sown Clearing
fusions.desc: Sows a growth where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it, within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Contagious Roost
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance.
